metadata.description: Claude Code skills from LocalPro Solutions: hatch and raise-the-bar.

plugins.name: hatch
plugins.description: Turn a fuzzy problem, half-baked idea, or risky decision into a shipped, defended result. Frame, diverge, judge, red-team, build, ship-gate.

plugins.name: raise-the-bar
plugins.description: Before calling work done, a fresh-context critic judges it against the original ask. SHIP or NOT YET, fix the one biggest gap, loop up to 3 rounds.
